_description: Anarchy Online profession reference. ids verified against AOSharp.Common/GameData\Profession.cs. id 13 (Monster) is not player-selectable and is omitted from the playable list.
_breedAvailability: In Anarchy Online there are NO breed restrictions on profession choice: every one of the 4 breeds (Solitus, Opifex, Nanomage, Atrox) can roll every playable profession. Keeper and Shade are the only professions gated behind an expansion (Shadowlands) rather than being free-to-play (froob) professions, but that is an account/expansion gate, not a breed gate. 'recommendedBreeds' lists community-preferred breeds for that profession by ability synergy; 'allowedBreeds' is always all four.

professions.name: Soldier
professions.role: Heavy ranged damage dealer; assault rifle / shotgun DPS with strong reflect/absorb survivability nanos.

professions.name: MartialArtist
professions.role: Unarmed melee striker; high burst with Martial Arts skill plus self-heals and evades.

professions.name: Engineer
professions.role: Robot pet class; strong damage/reflect pets, trade skills and team damage buffs.

professions.name: Fixer
professions.role: SMG runner/support; run-speed and HoT grafts, NCU buffs, evades and grid access.

professions.name: Agent
professions.role: Sniper/stealth; rifle + Aimed Shot, False Profession to cast other professions' nanos.

professions.name: Adventurer
professions.role: Hybrid all-rounder; morphs, self-heals, multiple weapon options and travel utility.

professions.name: Trader
professions.role: Debuff/buff support; skill-wrangle and drain nanos, team damage/AC buffs, best tradeskiller.

professions.name: Bureaucrat
professions.role: Crowd control / charm pet class; calms, roots and single-target debuffs plus a charmed pet.

professions.name: Enforcer
professions.role: Melee tank; high HP, taunts, Mongo rage buffs and big 2-hand weapons.

professions.name: Doctor
professions.role: Primary healer; strongest heals plus damage-over-time and ability/init debuffs.

professions.name: NanoTechnician
professions.role: Glass-cannon nuker; highest direct nano damage and strong AoE.

professions.name: Metaphysicist
professions.role: Multi-pet caster; attack/heal/mezz pets plus nuke and debuff nanos.

professions.name: Keeper
professions.role: Melee paladin/aura support; 2-hand-edged auras that buff team damage/heal/reflect (Shadowlands).

professions.name: Shade
professions.role: Dual-wield stealth assassin; fast piercing/knife attacks with drain procs (Shadowlands).

_sources: https://anarchyonline.fandom.com/wiki/Breed (any breed can be any profession; froob cannot select Keeper/Shade)
